method_note: Read the whole paper (main text, Table 1, supplementary methods). A script built the JSON; every span was resolved against the paper text and the Table 1 transcription was checked cell by cell against the table. Individuals: the case-report patient (label 'patient', rule 5; she is also Table 1 row #14, not given a second row; table spans cited for her where used); Table 1 rows #1-#13 (literature patients, labelled 'Table 1 #n' from the bare-number '#' column, Reference cell copied to source_reference_in_review); and 'ref ^25 patient' (previously reported LAD-I patient with the same variant, in scope because the paper gives the variant). Not given rows: the patient's healthy son (neither tested nor affected), the unnamed older sibling, the 'single prior mention' woman of ref ^13 (probably Table 1 #2, Kerkhof, female with pregnancy, but the paper does not say so), the four revertant-mosaicism patients (group only). Table 1: 'n/d' (defined 'no data') read as not reported; Mutation cells of #7 ('p. Lys196Thr/p. Arg593Cys') and #12 ('Intron 14+1delG/c.130A>C; p.Thr44Pro') split into two variant rows each, zygosity not reported (no '(hom)' and compound heterozygosity not stated); Table 1 prints no gene symbol, so gene_symbol_as_stated is 'not reported' for Table 1 variant rows; CD18 expression cell put in functional_evidence_statement for persons with a variant row only (for #1-#4, #6, #13 it has no field); 'Outcome' column read as outcome of the pyoderma and put in severity_or_detail, except 'Fatal (28 years)' (#2) also recorded as deceased at 28 years; 'otitis' (#1) not mapped to the otitis media checklist item (broader term); 'Pyoderma manifestation' cell used as onset of the PG-like feature, not as disease onset. Contradiction: age at diagnosis of the patient is 'at the age of 2 years' in the text and abstract, '1 years' in Table 1 and '1 year 7 months' in the supplement; recorded the text value. Patient: 'Her umbilical cord fell off normally' recorded as delayed umbilical cord separation excluded; 'umbilical wound healed without features' not used to exclude omphalitis; 'without life-threatening infections' recorded excluded for the period from 1 year of age although she later had sepsis at 14 years; normal serum IgA/IgM/IgG recorded as low immunoglobulins excluded; inheritance not reported (no parental testing stated, only 'inherited original mutation'); variant type 'splice' from 'the patient has a mutation at the splice site'; for the ref ^25 patient the cDNA and transcript come from the patient's WES sentence via 'This variant', and variant type and zygosity were left not reported. n_patients_reported left null: the authors state no count of ITGB2-variant patients.
